title: Kissed Flaky Canadian Potato Grill
description: A comforting Canadian dish featuring flaky potatoes, parmesan cheese, and a crispy grilled exterior, perfect for a sick day. This egg-free friendly recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and grated cheese, tossing to coat the potatoes evenly.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Pour the butter mixture over the potatoes and cheese, tossing to coat the potatoes completely.
Line a grill basket with aluminum foil, leaving some overhang for easy removal.
Add the potato mixture to the grill basket, spreading it out in an even layer.
Grill the potatoes for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the potatoes from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
